name: Qgo Finance Ltd.
summary: Qgo Finance Ltd., a non-banking financial company (NBFC) based in Mumbai, India, was established on July 28, 1993. The firm offers a broad spectrum of financial services, primarily focusing on funding the hire purchase of diverse assets. This includes various vehicles such as buses, specialized lottery trucks, cars, and other passenger or goods transport vehicles, alongside general and tractor equipment, machinery, buildings, and miscellaneous articles. Furthermore, Qgo Finance provides capital for the acquisition and disposal of a wide array of items like industrial machinery, plant tools, jigs, fixtures, agricultural equipment, vessels, automobiles, computers, office equipment, air-conditioning units, and electronic devices.
